subject.name: Cryptography and Network Security
subject.title: CSIT-604 (A) - Cryptography and Network Security
commonInstructions: In case of any doubt or dispute the English version question should be treated as final.

subQuestions.label: a)
subQuestions.text: Define the term Cyber Security. Discuss the various types of attacks such as Operating System Level, Application Level and Misconfiguration vulnerabilities.

subQuestions.label: b)
subQuestions.text: Explain the concept of Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) and their types.

subQuestions.label: a)
subQuestions.text: Discuss the principles of Public Key Cryptography. Explain how RSA and Blowfish algorithms work.

subQuestions.label: b)
subQuestions.text: What is Diffie-Hellman key exchange? How is it used in secure communication?

subQuestions.label: a)
subQuestions.text: Explain the working of SHA (Secure Hash Algorithm) and its applications.

subQuestions.label: b)
subQuestions.text: What are Message Authentication Codes (MAC) and how do they differ from Message Digest Functions?

subQuestions.label: a)
subQuestions.text: Define Trojan Horses and discuss the different types of Trojans, including Remote Access Trojans and Proxy Trojans.

subQuestions.label: b)
subQuestions.text: Discuss Denial of Service (DoS) Attacks and explain the working of a SYN Flood Attack.

subQuestions.label: a)
subQuestions.text: Explain the concept of IP Security (IPSec). How does it secure communication over an IP network?

subQuestions.label: b)
subQuestions.text: What are the different types of Firewalls? Explain their operation and design principles.

subQuestions.label: a)
subQuestions.text: A Diffie-Hellman key exchange has a prime number $p = 23$ and a primitive root $g = 5$. Alice chooses a secret key $a = 6$, and Bob chooses a secret key $b = 15$. Find the shared secret key between Alice and Bob.

subQuestions.label: a)
subQuestions.text: RSA Algorithm is used with two prime numbers $p = 7$ and $q = 11$. Compute the public and private keys if $e = 5$.

subQuestions.label: a)
subQuestions.text: Explain the concept of System Hacking Cycle and its stages.

subQuestions.label: b)
subQuestions.text: Discuss the need and objectives of Computer Forensics in tracking cyber criminals.
